'''Star Tours Flight 629''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight traveling to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] and [[Umgul/Legends|Umgul]]. At the time of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight had just arrived back at the spaceport's Gate 1L in time for its planned arrival at 0720 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 0815.
